messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas (as of 2024)** | Topic | Key Points | Notes | |-------|------------|-------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• Exceeding by 5 mph or more is a misdemeanor.
• Exceeding by 10 mph or more is a felony. | • Limits vary by road type (e.g., 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates). | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety Seat** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat. | • Failure to buckle up is a misdemeanor. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08% is illegal.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | • Texas has a zero‑tolerance policy for drivers under 21. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | • Violations are misdemeanors. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights. | • Failure to yield can result in a misdemeanor. | | **School Bus** | • Must stop for school buses with flashing red lights. | • Failure to stop is a misdemeanor. | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Must signal and check blind spots.
• Overtaking on the right is prohibited unless the driver is turning left. | • Unsafe lane changes can lead to a misdemeanor. | | **Parking** | • Parking in no‑stop zones, fire lanes, or handicap spaces without proper permits is illegal. | • Violations are misdemeanors. | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and inspected annually. | • Failure to register or inspect can lead to a misdemeanor. | | **Traffic School** | • First‑time offenders may attend traffic school to avoid points on their license. | • Must be completed within 90 days of the ticket. | **How to Find Specific Laws** 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The primary source for all traffic statutes. 2. **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – Provides regulations, forms, and guidance. 3. **Local County Courts** – For specific citations and penalties. **Resources** - Texas Transportation Code (PDF) – [link](https://www.txdmv.gov/sites/default/files/2024-01/tx_transportation_code.pdf) - TxDMV Traffic Rules – [link](https://www.txdmv.gov/traffic-rules) - Texas Courts – [link](https://www.txcourts.gov/) Feel free to ask if you need details on a particular law or how to handle a specific traffic ticket!
